# MS Construction Services

> MS Construction Services is a construction company based in Lahore, Pakistan, operating since 1994. It specializes in Gray Structure, House Construction, and Commercial Construction, with a strong track record in Bahria Town (Sector A, Sector C, and Sector E) and Lake City, alongside projects across the rest of Lahore.

Key facts:
- Founded: 1994 (32+ years in business)
- Location: Lahore, Pakistan (address: 30, Block C, OPF Housing Scheme, Lahore, 54000)
- Phone / WhatsApp: 0306-1982828
- Services: Gray Structure Construction, House Construction, Commercial Construction
- Areas served: Lahore, Bahria Town (Sector A, C, E), Lake City
- Rating: 5.0 out of 5 from 16 Google reviews
- Offer: Free site visit, fixed itemized quote within 24 hours, 30-day price lock, no hidden costs
- Capacity: Only 3 new projects accepted per month

## Materials Used (Grey Structure)

Maple Leaf Cement, Mughal Supreme Steel 60 Grade, semi special bricks, Chenab and Ravi pure sand, Sargodha plant crush, Bajri aggregate, steel shuttering.
